title: Accessible by default
look: Session board on a dot-grid desk: a player with the a11y add-on bolted beside it, a captioned film frame, four keyboard keys, one standard toolbar over three small films, and the emaki end card. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what is wrong, jade for what is right.

scenes.name: The add-on
scenes.desc: A motion player with captions off and the a11y add-on bolted on beside it.

scenes.name: Captions from the script
scenes.desc: A film frame with a CC badge and a caption bar quoting the voice script.

scenes.name: Keyboard controls
scenes.desc: Four keys: play, seek, scenes, captions.
